system.biography:
The greatest of gods and ostensible ruler of the Celestial Bureaucracy. Ignis Divine rules largely in absentia through functionaries. He has 10 purchases each of Essence Plethora, Reserve of Will, and Ox-Body Technique. It costs him 100 motes to materialize.

Source: Glories of the Most High: The Unconquered Sun.
